claim_boundary: Pure variational-QNN arm on the fresh grouped-split protocol. No quantum advantage is asserted. A QNN win is admissible only if the per-seed paired comparison against the committed classical poly-2 arm is 'significant' after Holm correction with achieved power >= 0.8, n >= 10, a bootstrap CI of the paired difference excluding zero, and a matched data budget. The default 4 qubits and 3 epochs are CPU-feasibility choices, not a hardware or scaling claim. The QNN consumes a TRAIN-only projection of the frozen cached features into a small amplitude register; any unequal input-information budget versus the classical control is recorded and no performance difference is attributed to quantum effects. The sealed TEST is scored exactly once per seed; every reported value comes from an executed run and failures are recorded as warnings, never fabricated.

comparisons.decision_reason: p_holm<alpha, bootstrap CI excludes 0, power>=0.8, n>=10
